Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – proposal for a fixed-price 36-month package
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for taking the time to discuss our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels, and we appreciate the effort your team puts into reviewing a longer-term arrangement with us.

Would you kindly consider a fixed price of EUR 4.70/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net and a 36-month contract? Our annual requirement is 23,700 kg, with DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges. We hope the prompt payment and longer commitment make this a useful package for your business as well.

For context, our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognize that these earlier purchases do not tell the whole story of your costs today, and we understand that this is a substantial request. EUR 4.70/kg is the price at which we can move forward with the package above. We would be grateful if you could review it with the colleague responsible for pricing and let us know whether you can offer these terms as your binding proposal.

Thank you again for considering this. We would be very pleased to reach an agreement together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your proposal for a 36-month contract and the prompt 14-day payment terms, which we are pleased to incorporate into our offer. Please note that for a long-term agreement of 36 months, a fixed price is not feasible; we must apply the AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material fluctuations. 

Reflecting your historical purchase data and the improved payment terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.40 per kg. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – our fixed-price package for 2027 onwards
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing our proposal with your team, and for your revised offer of EUR 5.30/kg with 14-day payment and a 36-month term. We appreciate the effort and the time this has taken.

We understand your concern that a fixed price over 36 months leaves Werdenfels exposed to AS-14404 movements, and we take that seriously. For our planning, certainty over the full term is an important part of what makes this arrangement work for us. We hope the prompt payment and the longer commitment help balance that for you.

To proceed, we would still need the fixed EUR 4.70/kg package with 14-day payment and a 36-month commitment. The other terms are unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, a 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01 and no tooling. If your team can approve it as a binding offer, we would be very pleased to conclude promptly.

Thank you again for your consideration.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always value working with you and supporting your operations with our extensive inventory and service. We understand your desire for planning certainty over the full 36-month term. However, as your target price and terms remain unchanged, we are unable to make further concessions. 

We must maintain our offer of EUR 5.30 per kg with the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over three years exposes us to unsustainable raw material risks. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Please note our Angebot stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
